name: io.github.antonorlov/mcp-postgres-server
title: PostgreSQL
description: MCP server for PostgreSQL: local, Docker, RDS, Neon, Supabase, or behind an SSH bastion.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

environmentVariables.name: PG_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

environmentVariables.name: PG_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Database port.

environmentVariables.name: PG_USER
environmentVariables.description: Database user.

environmentVariables.name: PG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Database password.

environmentVariables.name: PG_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Database name.

environmentVariables.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSLMODE
environmentVariables.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSL_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

environmentVariables.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
environmentVariables.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

environmentVariables.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

environmentVariables.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

environmentVariables.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: SSH bastion port.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_USER
environmentVariables.description: SSH username.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.
